name: Restless spirit
description: A withered warrior spirit in battle-scarred armor with two spears in its chest that attacks Kirol's group, and later Lluwen's.

timeline.summary: Kirol uses a war cry to dissolve a restless spirit that attacked while he carried a caryatid to Camp Herrian.
timeline.quote: I guess it was pretty good—they dissolved back into the currents.

timeline.summary: Tam consoles Lluwen and tells him of a frightening encounter with the same spirit, who threw a spear at her group.
timeline.quote: He hurled a spectral spear at me.

timeline.summary: Ajani slashes the spear and destroys the spirit with his axe, then tells his charge to be more careful.
timeline.quote: He slashed the spear in two, and in the same motion brought the flat of his axe down on the spirit's head.
